name: Spectre
ability: Each Night* pick 2 people, the first dies and the second doesn't wake up [-1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: Spectre points to a player then to another, the first dies and the second doesn't wake up

name: Baa
ability: Each Night* pick someone they die, Outsiders think they are a Townsfolk, They learn who they are when they die [+1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: The Baa points to a player, Wake any outsiders that have died any tell them who they are.

jinxes.reason: The Rambler knows who they are

The Ogre knows who they are
The Milkman knows who they are
The Zealot knows who they are
The Puzzlemaster knows who they are
The Saint knows who they are

The Drunk doesn't learn who they are

name: Shaman
ability: There can be duplicate Outsiders up to 3 of the same outsider [+1-2 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: Only 1 Rambler needs to ramble for it to count
Only 1 Damsel may be in play
Only 1 Saint may be in play
Only 1 Milkman may be in play
Only 1 Puzzlemaster may be in play
If the only good players are Zealot's, they learn this and may vote how ever they like.

name: Recruiter
ability: Once per game at night pick someone, if they're a Good Outsider they turn Evil, otherwise they learn who you are [+0-1 Outsiders]
firstNightReminder: Wake the player to point or shake their head, if they pick someone that is not a good outsider wake that player and show the Recruiter token and point to the Recruiter.
otherNightReminder: Wake the player to point or shake their head, if they pick someone that is not a good outsider wake that player and show the Recruiter token and point to the Recruiter.

name: Accountant
ability: Townsfolk abilities pick the player one step Clockwise of who they picked, a Good Townsfolk learns you are in play. [-1 Outsider]
firstNightReminder: Wake a good player and show the Accountant token.

name: Milkman
ability: After 3 days turn Evil, publicly say "I am the Milkman, my milk is delicious" to delay this by a day, tonight someone gets false info
firstNightReminder: Mark the Milkman with the 3 Days token
otherNightReminder: If the Milkman didn't Advertise place the next token, if there on the last day, wake them and tell them they are Evil.

name: Rambler
ability: Each day, be the first to nominate someone and talk about something unrelated, if you fail someone might not wake up tonight.
otherNightReminder: If the Rambler didn't ramble you may mark someone with the "Doesn't wake" token

name: Doppelganger
ability: You think you are a in play Townsfolk role and have their ability, either you or the person that had that role is drunk.

name: Jinx
ability: When you die someone that would wake up at night doesn't
otherNightReminder: Place the "Doesn't wake" token on someone that would've woken up

name: Mailman
ability: Start knowing one role that is in play and one that isn't
firstNightReminder: Wake the Mailman and show a role that is in play and then one that is not in play.

name: Poet
ability: Start knowing any info the storyteller gives you.

name: Architect
ability: Start knowing which half of the grim is more evil
firstNightReminder: Learn which half is more evil, if equal learn whichever half.

name: Confessor
ability: Each night if you are not drunk or poisoned learn that you are the Confessor, if someone  is "mad" they are sober and healthy confessor and is not they may be executed
firstNightReminder: Wake the Confessor and tell them they are the Confessor
otherNightReminder: Wake the Confessor and tell them they are the Confessor

name: Physician
ability: Each night pick someone, them and your Townsfolk neighbors are sober and healthy till dusk.
firstNightReminder: The Physician points to some one, they and the Physician's neighbors are sober and healthy.
otherNightReminder: The Physician points to some one, they and the Physician's neighbors are sober and healthy.

name: Baker
ability: Once per game if you publicly claim to be the baker, 1-3 Townsfolk become a Baker that night.
otherNightReminder: If the Baker claimed, wake 1-3 players and show them they are the Baker.

name: Vigilante
ability: If you died by the demon you learn this at night, in the day when your death is announced pick someone, if evil they die.
otherNightReminder: If died to the demon, tell them.
